name: Train Track
description: Wooden-railway track pieces compatible with BRIO, IKEA LILLABO and other 40 mm wooden train track: straights, curves, an ascending ramp, a 90-degree crossing, an end stop with a buffer, and a name tile with a word inlaid between the rails. Standard 40 x 12 mm profile with two 6 x 3 mm grooves, round peg and socket connectors with a clearance slider. Prints flat without supports. The track prints on extruder 1; the word, when there is one, on extruder 2.
source: inspired by Printables "Extended Set of Wooden Train Track with 50+ Unique Pieces" (#117903, 14.8k downloads) and "Connectors - Brio/IKEA Wooden Train Track" (#48018, 5.5k downloads); profile from woodenrailway.info's track guide
